Discover by day, practice after school

Explore robotics. Practice robotics. Grow robotics.

The CBC STEM Center supports robotics learning in multiple ways. Visiting students can explore robotics through The FIRST Robotics Experience, while local FIRST LEGO League and FIRST Tech Challenge teams can reserve official practice fields to test, tune, and improve their robots throughout the season.

Why field access matters

Teams need time on realistic fields to test autonomous programs, adjust mechanisms, improve driver skills, and prepare for competitions. CBC can provide a neutral, community-centered location where teams can practice with reliable access to season-specific field elements.

Students in action

Hands-on mission testing

FLL teams can reserve table time to practice missions, adjust attachments, and collaborate around the field.

Practice field access

Realistic robot testing

FTC teams can use field time to test, tune, and improve before competitions and scrimmages.

Practice facilities

Reserve the field your team needs.

Booking options are designed around the two major FIRST programs featured in The FIRST Robotics Experience.

FIRST LEGO League

FLL Practice Table

Teams use the current-season challenge table to test missions, refine robot attachments, troubleshoot programs, and improve consistency before events.

Official-style challenge table Mission testing 2 booking slots
FIRST Tech Challenge

FTC Practice Field

Teams reserve field time to test autonomous routines, tune drive performance, practice scoring systems, and prepare for competition using realistic field elements.

Full practice field Autonomous testing 4 booking slots

Request a team practice reservation.

Coaches or adult mentors can request field time for robot testing, tuning, programming, and driver practice.

  • Choose the FLL or FTC field
  • Select preferred date and time
  • Share team information and expected attendance
  • Receive confirmation from the STEM Center team

Reservation Request

This mockup form is not connected to a live reservation system.

Shared space guidelines

Designed to keep the space useful, safe, and fair.

📅

Reservation Window

Teams may request field time up to 60 days in advance.

⏱️

Session Length

Standard practice sessions are two hours unless approved for a special event.

👥

Supervision

An adult coach, mentor, or approved volunteer must be present with students.

🧰

Respect Equipment

Fields and game elements are shared community resources and should be reset after use.

From first visit to team practice.

Students may first discover robotics through The FIRST Robotics Experience, then return with a local team to test, tune, and prepare for competition using the STEM Center's practice fields.
